message.content: The company faces the risk that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion, which would be confirmed if management states that the supply environment is less flexible than a year ago [D3]. The company also faces the risk that one-time tariff impacts in fiscal 2026 will not repeat, creating a high comparison bar for future profitability, which would be confirmed if executives caution that these impacts artificially pulled up profitability that won't repeat [D3]. Additionally, the company faces the risk that supply chain conditions are nonlinear and require an 18-month-plus view of planning, which would be confirmed if management describes revenue conversion as likely to be nonlinear over the next few quarters due to external component supply dependencies [D4].
